title: Iterative Data-Consistent Inversion with Multiple Push-forward Constraints
summary: A foundational challenge in uncertainty quantification involves estimating a probability measure on the space of uncertain parameters such that its push-forward through a computational model matches an observed probability measure on the output data associated with quantities of interest (QoI). When multiple, distinct sets of observational data are available, the desired parameter measure should simultaneously satisfy multiple push-forward constraints associated with various subsets of the QoI.
